title: Let's build a better Future
content:
![a better Future](https://www.henkel.com/resource/image/1175022/16x9/3840/2160/60046877f5e25144bf3f7352375d187f/31C614F03FB30A5AC7709221F1D8C992/header-global-challenges.jpg)

Not like the brazen giant of Greek fame,

With conquering limbs astride from land to land;

Here at our sea-washed, sunset gates shall stand

A mighty woman with a torch, whose flame

Is the imprisoned lightning, and her name

Mother of Exiles. From her beacon-hand

Glows world-wide welcome; her mild eyes command

The air-bridged harbor that twin cities frame.

"Keep, ancient lands, your storied pomp!" cries she

With silent lips. "Give me your tired, your poor,

Your huddled masses yearning to breathe free,

The wretched refuse of your teeming shore.

Send these, the homeless, tempest-tost to me,

I lift my lamp beside the golden door!"

[Emma Lazarus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Lazarus)
November 2, 1883

[**Associate Professor and Canada Research Chair**](https://experts.mcmaster.ca/display/lashitea) DeGroote School of Business, McMaster University [**Non-Resident Fellow**](https://www.brookings.edu/experts/addisu-lashitew) Global Economy and Development, Brookings Institution I am an Associate Professor and Canada Research Chair in Sustainable Enterprise (Tier 2) at the DeGroote School of Business, McMaster University. I also serve as a Non-Resident Fellow at the Brookings Institution in Washington, DC, and an Adjunct Associate Professor at the University of Cape Town in South Africa. At DeGroote, I teach Sustainability and International Business courses within the commerce program. My research focuses broadly on business and society, specifically examining critical social and environmental issues. My work has been published in leading academic journals, including the *Journal of Management Studies*, *Journal of International Business Studies*, *Entrepreneurship Theory and Practice*, and *Research Policy*. If you have questions or inquiries, please reach out to me at [lashitea@mcmaster.ca](mailto:lashitea@mcmaster.ca). title: Teaching
content:
I teach Sustainability and International Business courses within the undergraduate commerce program at the DeGroote School of Business (DSB). I have also contributed to our MBA elective course on case analysis at DSB. Internationally, I have taught graduate-level courses in Research Methods at Addis Ababa University and the University of Cape Town, where I hold an Adjunct Associate Professor position.

I have extensive experience supervising both graduate and undergraduate students. If you are interested in pursuing a PhD in Strategic Management at DSB, I encourage you to review our [program website](https://phd.degroote.mcmaster.ca/) or [reach out to me directly](mailto:lashitea@mcmaster.ca) to discuss potential opportunities.
